name: Single stream, 256 in / 256 out
description: One request at a time, short chat-sized prompts, 256 output tokens. The cleanest number for 'how fast does this feel for one person', and the workload the bandwidth-bound decode ceiling (memory bandwidth / weight size) is compared against.
notes: metrics_required is deliberately short so that hand-recorded single-stream measurements (SPEC section 10) can be submitted with only the numbers that were really observed. A harness run should also fill ttft_ms, tpot_ms and decode_tok_s_per_request.
